src/main/java/net/legendofwar/lobbyhd/Pl.summary: `PlayerPortals.java` manages in-game portal interactions via `init()`, handling faction (`Volk`) changes and player teleportation within the lobby project.

src/main/java/net/legendofwar/lobbyhd/Lo.summary: `LobbyHD` is the main plugin class that initializes the project, managing startup routines, event listeners, and global plugin access via `getInstance()`.

src/main/java/net/legendofwar/lobbyhd/Qu.summary: `QuestBarDisplay` manages player boss bars to visually track active quests and progress. It exports the `QuestBarDisplay` class, serving as the lobby quest HUD controller.

src/main/java/net/legendofwar/lobbyhd/co.summary: `CommandHandler` registers plugin commands during the lifecycle events phase using its primary `init()` method, serving as the central command registration hub for the project.
`SpawnCommand` implements and registers the `/spawn` command using Paper's Brigadier API. Its primary method, `register`, handles teleporting players to the world spawn.

src/main/java/net/legendofwar/lobbyhd/Wo.summary: `WorldProtection` is a Bukkit event listener that prevents non-creative players from modifying the environment (breaking/placing blocks and using buckets). It secures the lobby world against griefing.

src/main/java/net/legendofwar/lobbyhd/np.summary: `HumanNPC` extends `MannequinNPC` to spawn a custom skinned NPC in the lobby world, serving as an interactive human entity within the plugin.
`ElbNPC` manages the "König der Elben" mannequin NPC, configuring its custom skin and spawn location. It serves as an interactive lobby entity within the NPC module.

This file defines the `LisaNPC` class, which extends `MannequinNPC` to spawn and configure the "Lisa" interactive lobby NPC. It serves as a specialized non-player character within the project's NPC module.

This file defines the `SabrinaNPC` class, which extends `MannequinNPC` to spawn and manage the Sabrina lobby NPC. It serves as a specialized interactive character entity within the project's NPC system.
This file defines the `OrkNPC` class, extending `MannequinNPC` to spawn and configure an Ork King NPC within the lobby world.
This file defines the `ZwergNPC` class, which spawns and configures the "König der Zwerge" custom mannequin NPC within the lobby.
